title: Nutrition bar (South Beach Living Meal Bar)

content.title: About
content.content: Nutrition bar (South Beach Living Meal Bar) is a protein snack created as part of the South Beach Diet program. It provides a balanced mix of protein, slow‑digesting carbohydrates, healthy fats, and added vitamins and minerals to support energy and satiety throughout the day.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Developed by South Beach Diet nutritionists and suitable for low‑glycemic meal plans.
Each bar delivers about 20 g of protein from whey and soy isolates.
Contains whole grains (oat flakes, whole‑grain rice) for gradual energy release.
No artificial colors or flavors – only natural extracts are used.
Packaging is made from recyclable material to reduce environmental impact.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: 20 g of protein per bar helps maintain muscle mass and speeds recovery after workouts.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: The blend of slow carbs and fiber provides stable blood sugar levels and prolonged fullness.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Enriched with B‑vitamins, vitamin D, calcium and magnesium to support metabolic function and bone health.

items.title: Healthy fats
items.content: Includes plant oils (almond, sunflower) rich in mono‑ and poly‑unsaturated fats beneficial for heart health.

items.title: Weight‑management support
items.content: Balanced macronutrient profile helps control appetite and reduce overeating.

items.title: Milk and soy allergy
items.content: The bar contains whey protein and soy isolate, which may trigger reactions in allergic individuals.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although low GI, the bar contains a modest amount of sugar; those strictly limiting sugar should account for it in daily intake.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: One bar provides roughly 210 kcal; it should be counted within total daily calories during weight loss.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Contains wheat‑derived ingredients, making it unsuitable for gluten‑free diets.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The bar is convenient as a snack between meals or before training. It can be eaten whole or split in half and paired with yogurt, fruit, or a protein shake.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the package tightly sealed to maintain crunchiness. For longer storage (over 3 months) refrigerate.
